codes.capability-unknown: A required runtime capability did not resolve to an explicit supported or unsupported result.
codes.command-failed: A checked adapter command returned a nonzero exit code.
codes.command-timeout: A checked adapter command exceeded its declared timeout.
codes.configuration-invalid: The manifest, overlay, selector, or command configuration is invalid.
codes.console-error: A live browser case reported an unexpected console or player error.
codes.expectation-mismatch: Structured adapter output did not satisfy an explicit case expectation.
codes.fixture-hash-mismatch: A fixture SHA-256 differs from the reviewed manifest record.
codes.fixture-missing: A required repository or environment-backed fixture is unavailable.
codes.fixture-size-mismatch: A fixture byte length differs from the reviewed manifest record.
codes.input-missing: A private or runtime adapter input was not supplied through its declared environment variable.
codes.ownership-warning: A decoder sample, frame, finalizer, or ownership warning was observed.
codes.required-case-missing: A selected matrix does not contain one of its required case IDs.
codes.required-check-missing: A selected matrix or case does not contain one of its required check IDs.
codes.resource-leak: A retention gate found an unretired resource or an out-of-bounds resource trend.
codes.result-invalid: An adapter emitted malformed or unsupported structured evidence.
codes.tool-missing: A fixed adapter executable is unavailable.
codes.unexpected-transcode: Live Jellyfin negotiation selected a transcode not permitted by the case.
codes.unsanitized-secret: A report still contained a declared credential, private input, or signed URL after sanitization.
